name: taskchad-build-grow
description: Build reviewable business websites, inspect technical SEO/GEO artifacts, and keep business briefs and delivery history in TaskChad OS.

interface.longDescription: Create business briefs, generate website drafts, inspect technical SEO/GEO issues, and review versioned deliverables through a configured TaskChad OS connection. Website generation and artifact auditing are local workflows; publication and live ranking measurement are separate actions.
defaultPrompt: Build a website from my business brief and prepare it for review.
Audit my website files for technical SEO and GEO issues.
Show my TaskChad projects and the deliverables awaiting review.
